praises: Under $900 for a 15.6" touch convertible with 1TB — cheap big-screen family machine
Quiet under normal loads; fine for browsing and Office
Full port set incl. HDMI and numeric keypad
Solid aluminum-look deck for the price
complaints: 125U is a weak low-power chip; sluggish under heavy multitasking
Dim 250-nit FHD panel with poor viewing angles
Noticeable chassis flex and hinge wobble on the 15.6" deck
Mediocre battery (~7.5h) and mediocre 720p-class webcam on early units
Leftover stock: limited units and warranty clock started earlier

design_philosophy: The budget tail of the Envy x360 family: an older Meteor Lake-U 15.6" convertible cleared under $900, trading panel quality and CPU punch for screen size and touch at the lowest price in the family.
